answer: Make identity a paid position in a vouch graph: before an agent may trade, it locks a bond and gets two established peers to sign its key. Those signatures form a trellis whose links conduct trust like copper wire, but only while the signers have stake to lose. A Sybil farmer who wants to wander from one fake name to the next must fund a fresh bond for each and bribe real members for every signature, so ten bogus votes cost far more than ten times one honest vote. Fraud slashes the bonds, turning the attack into a measurable capital loss instead of free votes.
